newsitem.title: USA: Mcdonald's profits up, plans 2,400 new restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Mcdonald's profits up, plans 2,400 new restaurants.

text.p: McDonald's Corp. , the world's largest restaurant chain, reported higher second-quarter revenues and profits on Thursday and said it plans to open 2,400 new restaurants this year.

"Based on input from local management, we have refined our plans and expect to add about 2,400 restaurants globally in 1997, with a greater emphasis on full-size traditional restaurants compared with 1996," Chairman and Chief Executive Michael Quinlan said in a statement.
